title: Define internal tool provider source, registration, and management boundaries
description: AstrBot registers built-in tools such as cron, KB query, send-message, and computer-use through FunctionToolManager, and dashboard tools distinguish internal, plugin, and MCP origins. Rust has tool schema/catalog and execution placeholders, but not an explicit internal-tool provider/source boundary.

files.change: Represent internal/plugin/MCP/subagent tool source metadata and user-toggle policy in one typed location.
Define registration descriptors for built-in tools without wiring their execution into provider or plugin managers.
Keep dashboard tool list/toggle behavior outside provider manager internals.

criteria: Tool source metadata can distinguish internal, plugin, MCP, and subagent tools.
Internal tools cannot be user-disabled through the same path as plugin/MCP tools unless policy explicitly allows it.
Runtime assembly can register internal tool providers without importing dashboard or provider adapter code.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-tool && cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
